title: Playing house parties and later the public halls
summary: His own group played house parties, with furniture cleared out, for birthdays, weddings and christenings. Later he played the public halls with other bands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And I put the words to it and he gave me the music. Now, you said you had your own group when you were about 15 or 16. Yeah. What type of parties and such did you play for?
Well, mostly it would be house parties. People would clear the house of all the furniture and give different birthday parties, weddings, and christenings and different things like that.
Did you play any of the regular public dance halls later on? Oh yeah. Same halls I mentioned before. Those were with the other bands though?
